answer.text: Long one stock, short a correlated 'pair' stock, profiting from relative mispricing

explanation.text: The Logic: Pairs trading goes long one stock, short a correlated pair, profiting from mean-reversion in spread. The Trap: Single-stock/IPO/ETF strategies are different. Cross-Exam Context: Common stat arb variant. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Correlation breakdowns kill pair trades — monitor correlation stability.
